conflicts.description: Two SIP totals for FY 2026-27 on the same AMFI page differ by ₹32,490 crore, which equals September's contribution. The 'Total during FY' row (₹1,58,108 crore) therefore appears to stop at August, while the April to September row (₹1,90,598 crore) includes September. Claude's arithmetic: the six monthly figures April to September sum to ₹1,90,598 crore. A human decides which, if either, may be used.
conflicts.resolution: F010 (April-September row, Rs 1,90,598 crore) is used. F009 rejected: its 'Total during FY' row appears to stop at August. Decision relayed by Deepesh on 2026-11-11.
